name: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd
title: SKF India (Industrial) Ltd - 544572 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 sales up 9.8% QoQ to INR 9.5bn with OEM mix rising to 50% and margin ex one-offs at 11.5% (down from 13.1%), guided back to ~13% near term and ~15% by FY29-30 with ~INR 800 crore capex, new Pune plant by end-2028.

capex.quote: we are looking at doing a c apex spend of around INR 800 crores plus, which includes a significant chunk of investment on the new Pune plant

triggers.label: Capex ~INR 800 crore plan to FY30
triggers.quote: we are looking at doing a c apex spend of around INR 800 crores plus

triggers.label: Price increases to offset FX and cost
triggers.quote: we have taken some pricing actions already in the market given the cost escalation that we are seeing
triggers.highlight: taken some pricing actions already in the market

triggers.label: Margin back to ~13% near term
triggers.quote: We should get back to a little more around 13 %.
triggers.highlight: get back to a little more around 13 %

triggers.label: Distributor payments cause volume shift
triggers.quote: we made some corrections to distributors whose payments were outstanding
triggers.highlight: corrections to distributors whose payments were outstanding

guidance.quote: we are going to get to around 15 %. More increase is possible, but we can't commit to it right now.
the growth will continue to be in the range of I believe we have forecasted around 8%
which we expect in the range of 19% to 20% going forward, 19% to 20% of sales
we expect the new Pune plant to be commissioned by end of 2028

red_flags.label: Margin decline on mix and higher costs
red_flags.quote: the mix of lower margin OEM business compared to higher margin distribution business accounted for most of this drop

red_flags.label: Receivables and intercompany payables stretched
red_flags.quote: We also had a higher , accounts receivable driven by more sales, especially the intercompany sales to SKF India Limited.
